verdict.rationale: skills.sh ships an official, first-party `npx skills` CLI with documented commands. These cover add, use, list, find, update, remove, init and lockfile restore, and include agent-targeting flags and a non-interactive `-y` mode for CI. `skills use … | claude` pipes a generated prompt straight into an agent. Hands-on runtime probes confirm it runs without an account or API key, automatically switches to promptless mode when driven by Claude Code, and can list a repo's skills without installing them. One community complaint says the tool doesn't handle updating, but the documented `update`/`remove` commands answer it, so it is not a concrete contradiction.
